newsitem.title: USA: Fed okays Northwest Savings application.
newsitem.headline: Fed okays Northwest Savings application.

text.p: Northwest Savings Bank said Tuesday that the Federal Reserve Board of Governors has approved its application to reorganize into a two-tier holding company, subject to approval by state regulators and its shareholders.

The company said it will adapt a two-tier holding company structure in which the bank forms a new, state-chartered, stock holding company as its parent, and which is owned by current shareholders. It, in turn, will own all common stock of Northwest Savings Bank.
All common stock held by existing shareholders will be converted to a shares of the new stockholding company.

Northwest said the new structure allows it to retain the benefits of its current mutual holding company structure while giving it greater flexibility in making acquisitions, diversifying operations and repurchasing shares.
Northwest has $2 billion in assets and operates 58 community banking offices in western and central Pennsylvania.
